title:
POV: I SAT WITH A WOMAN IN ISRAEL
FIGHTING CANCER WHO WON'T GIVE UP
beats: WALK IN: 'Hi, Eden. What's the situation? I heard about your story, that you have cancer, and I wanted to come and talk to you about your story.'
HER STORY: 'I'm Eden, 30, fighting leukemia for a year. I lost my mother a year ago.' - while she was sick herself
'She passed away from cancer.' / 'How long?' / '17 years.'
THE TURN: 'Because I need to be strong - for everyone, for myself, for my family.'
'And what is your dream?' 'To be a healthy girl. To take care of myself.'
HER MESSAGE: 'you can't give up when it's hard. You can shake, be a little sad - but don't lie down. Lift your head up.'
THE LIFT - the singers walk in: 'Hi, Eden. How are you?'
CLOSE on Tal, the ask: 'I want you to make Eden's dream come true. Two things - pray for her, and come visit her.'
